+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4.1-mini"
+
+
+def check_ocr_safety(extracted_text: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    prompt = (
+        "Analyze the following OCR-extracted document text for unsafe content. "
+        "Return only valid JSON with keys: safe (boolean), categories (array of strings), "
+        "reason (string), and redacted_excerpt (string). Text:\n\n"
+        f"{extracted_text}"
+    )
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={
+            "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+            "messages": [
+                {"role": "system", "content": "You are a safety classifier for OCR text."},
+                {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
+            ],
+            "temperature": 0,
+        },
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    try:
+        import json
+
+        parsed = json.loads(content)
+    except Exception:
+        parsed = {"safe": False, "categories": ["unparseable"], "reason": content, "redacted_excerpt": ""}
+    return parsed
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import sys
+
+    text = sys.stdin.read()
+    result = check_ocr_safety(text)
+    import json
+
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import os
+import sys
+from typing import List
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def _read_input() -> str:
+    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
+        return " ".join(sys.argv[1:]).strip()
+    return sys.stdin.read().strip()
+
+
+def translate_ocr_text(text: str, target_language: str = "English") -> str:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model="gpt-5.4-mini",
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": f"Translate OCR text into {target_language}. Preserve line breaks, numbers, and formatting as much as possible. Return only the translated text.",
+            },
+            {"role": "user", "content": text},
+        ],
+    )
+    return response.output_text.strip()
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    text = _read_input()
+    if not text:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+    target_language = os.environ.get("TARGET_LANGUAGE", "English")
+    print(translate_ocr_text(text, target_language))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from azure.ai.formrecognizer import DocumentAnalysisClient
+from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DocumentServiceConfig:
+    endpoint: str
+    api_key: str
+    ocr_model: str = "prebuilt-read"
+    layout_model: str = "prebuilt-layout"
+
+
+def load_config() -> DocumentServiceConfig:
+    endpoint = os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT") or os.getenv("AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_ENDPOINT")
+    api_key = os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY") or os.getenv("AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_KEY")
+    if not endpoint:
+        raise ValueError("Missing Azure Document Intelligence endpoint environment variable")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("Missing Azure Document Intelligence key environment variable")
+    return DocumentServiceConfig(
+        endpoint=endpoint,
+        api_key=api_key,
+        ocr_model=os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_OCR_MODEL", "prebuilt-read"),
+        layout_model=os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_LAYOUT_MODEL", "prebuilt-layout"),
+    )
+
+
+def create_client(config: Optional[DocumentServiceConfig] = None) -> DocumentAnalysisClient:
+    cfg = config or load_config()
+    return DocumentAnalysisClient(endpoint=cfg.endpoint, credential=AzureKeyCredential(cfg.api_key))
+
+
+def analyze_ocr(source: Any, config: Optional[DocumentServiceConfig] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    cfg = config or load_config()
+    client = create_client(cfg)
+    poller = client.begin_analyze_document(cfg.ocr_model, source)
+    result = poller.result()
+    return result.to_dict()
+
+
+def analyze_layout(source: Any, config: Optional[DocumentServiceConfig] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    cfg = config or load_config()
+    client = create_client(cfg)
+    poller = client.begin_analyze_document(cfg.layout_model, source)
+    result = poller.result()
+    return result.to_dict()
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT = os.environ["AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT"].rstrip("/")
+AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY = os.environ["AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY"]
+AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_VERSION = os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_VERSION", "2024-11-30")
+AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_MODEL_ID = os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_MODEL_ID", "prebuilt-layout")
+
+
+def _headers() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    return {
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY,
+    }
+
+
+def _submit_document(content: bytes) -> str:
+    payload = {"base64Source": base64.b64encode(content).decode("ascii")}
+    url = (
+        f"{AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT}/documentintelligence/documentModels/"
+        f"{AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_MODEL_ID}:analyze?api-version={AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_VERSION}"
+    )
+    response = requests.post(url, headers=_headers(), json=payload, timeout=120)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    operation_url = response.headers.get("operation-location") or response.headers.get("Operation-Location")
+    if not operation_url:
+        raise RuntimeError("Azure Document Intelligence did not return an operation-location header")
+    return operation_url
+
+
+def _poll_result(operation_url: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    while True:
+        response = requests.get(operation_url, headers={"Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY}, timeout=120)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        result = response.json()
+        status = result.get("status")
+        if status in {"succeeded", "failed"}:
+            if status == "failed":
+                raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
+            return result
+
+
+def extract_tables(document_path: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    with open(document_path, "rb") as f:
+        operation_url = _submit_document(f.read())
+    result = _poll_result(operation_url)
+    analyze_result = result.get("analyzeResult", {})
+    tables = analyze_result.get("tables", [])
+    pages = analyze_result.get("pages", [])
+    lines_by_page = {}
+    for page in pages:
+        page_number = page.get("pageNumber")
+        lines_by_page[page_number] = page.get("lines", [])
+    extracted = []
+    for table in tables:
+        cells = []
+        for cell in table.get("cells", []):
+            cells.append({
+                "row_index": cell.get("rowIndex"),
+                "column_index": cell.get("columnIndex"),
+                "row_span": cell.get("rowSpan", 1),
+                "column_span": cell.get("columnSpan", 1),
+                "kind": cell.get("kind"),
+                "content": cell.get("content", ""),
+            })
+        extracted.append({
+            "row_count": table.get("rowCount"),
+            "column_count": table.get("columnCount"),
+            "cells": cells,
+            "bounding_regions": table.get("boundingRegions", []),
+            "spans": table.get("spans", []),
+            "lines_by_page": lines_by_page,
+        })
+    return extracted
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Extract table structure from a document using Azure Document Intelligence.")
+    parser.add_argument("document_path")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(extract_tables(args.document_path), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+        return None
+    if isinstance(polygon, list):

+        return [float(v) for v in polygon]
+    except TypeError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _serialize_layout(result: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    pages = []

+                    }

+                    {
+                        "content": getattr(word, "content", None),
+                        "confidence": getattr(word, "confidence", None),
+                        "span": _serialize_span(getattr(word, "span", None)) if getattr(word, "span", None) else None,
+                        "polygon": _serialize_polygon(getattr(word, "polygon", None)),
+                    }
+                    for word in getattr(page, "words", []) or []
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+
+    tables = []
+    for table in getattr(result, "tables", []) or []:
+        tables.append(
+            {
+                "row_count": getattr(table, "row_count", None),
+                "column_count": getattr(table, "column_count", None),
+                "cells": [
+                    {
+                        "row_index": getattr(cell, "row_index", None),
+                        "column_index": getattr(cell, "column_index", None),
+                        "content": getattr(cell, "content", None),
+                        "kind": getattr(cell, "kind", None),
+                        "spans": [_serialize_span(s) for s in getattr(cell, "spans", []) or []],
+                    }
+                    for cell in getattr(table, "cells", []) or []
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+
+    paragraphs = []
+    for para in getattr(result, "paragraphs", []) or []:
+        paragraphs.append(
+            {
+                "content": getattr(para, "content", None),
+                "role": getattr(para, "role", None),
+                "spans": [_serialize_span(s) for s in getattr(para, "spans", []) or []],
+            }
+        )
+
+    figures = []
+    for figure in getattr(result, "figures", []) or []:
+        figures.append(
+            {
+                "spans": [_serialize_span(s) for s in getattr(figure, "spans", []) or []],
+                "bounding_regions": [
+                    {
+                        "page_number": getattr(br, "page_number", None),
+                        "polygon": _serialize_polygon(getattr(br, "polygon", None)),
+                    }
+                    for br in getattr(figure, "bounding_regions", []) or []
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+
+    return {"pages": pages, "tables": tables, "paragraphs": paragraphs, "figures": figures}
+
+
+def extract_layout(source: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = _client()
+    with open(source, "rb") as f:
+        poller = client.begin_analyze_document("prebuilt-layout", analyze_request=f, content_type="application/octet-stream")
+    result = poller.result()
+    return _serialize_layout(result)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("source")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(extract_layout(args.source), ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+def _serialize_span(span: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"offset": getattr(span, "offset", None), "length": getattr(span, "length", None)}
+
+
+def _serialize_polygon(polygon: Any) -> Optional[List[float]]:
+    if polygon is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(polygon, list):
+        return [float(v) for v in polygon]
+    try:
+        return [float(v) for v in polygon]
+    except TypeError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _serialize_layout(result: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    pages = []
+    for page in getattr(result, "pages", []) or []:
+        pages.append(
+            {
+                "page_number": getattr(page, "page_number", None),
+                "width": getattr(page, "width", None),
+                "height": getattr(page, "height", None),
+                "unit": getattr(page, "unit", None),
+                "lines": [
+                    {
+                        "content": getattr(line, "content", None),
+                        "spans": [_serialize_span(s) for s in getattr(line, "spans", []) or []],
+                        "polygon": _serialize_polygon(getattr(line, "polygon", None)),
+                    }
+                    for line in getattr(page, "lines", []) or []
+                ],
+                "words": [
+                    {
+                        "content": getattr(word, "content", None),
+                        "confidence": getattr(word, "confidence", None),
+                        "span": _serialize_span(getattr(word, "span", None)) if getattr(word, "span", None) else None,
+                        "polygon": _serialize_polygon(getattr(word, "polygon", None)),
+                    }
+                    for word in getattr(page, "words", []) or []
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+
+    tables = []
+    for table in getattr(result, "tables", []) or []:
+        tables.append(
+            {
+                "row_count": getattr(table, "row_count", None),
+                "column_count": getattr(table, "column_count", None),
+                "cells": [
+                    {
+                        "row_index": getattr(cell, "row_index", None),
+                        "column_index": getattr(cell, "column_index", None),
+                        "content": getattr(cell, "content", None),
+                        "kind": getattr(cell, "kind", None),
+                        "spans": [_serialize_span(s) for s in getattr(cell, "spans", []) or []],
+                    }
+                    for cell in getattr(table, "cells", []) or []
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+
+    paragraphs = []
+    for para in getattr(result, "paragraphs", []) or []:
+        paragraphs.append(
+            {
+                "content": getattr(para, "content", None),
+                "role": getattr(para, "role", None),
+                "spans": [_serialize_span(s) for s in getattr(para, "spans", []) or []],
+            }
+        )
+
+    figures = []
+    for figure in getattr(result, "figures", []) or []:
+        figures.append(
+            {
+                "spans": [_serialize_span(s) for s in getattr(figure, "spans", []) or []],
+                "bounding_regions": [
+                    {
+                        "page_number": getattr(br, "page_number", None),
+                        "polygon": _serialize_polygon(getattr(br, "polygon", None)),
+                    }
+                    for br in getattr(figure, "bounding_regions", []) or []
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+
+    return {"pages": pages, "tables": tables, "paragraphs": paragraphs, "figures": figures}
+
+
+def extract_layout(source: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = _client()
+    with open(source, "rb") as f:
+        poller = client.begin_analyze_document("prebuilt-layout", analyze_request=f, content_type="application/octet-stream")
+    result = poller.result()
+    return _serialize_layout(result)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("source")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(extract_layout(args.source), ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
